what_changed: for halted_reason values beginning checker_ (checker_malformed, checker_outage), the supervisor no longer requires an abandoned-call ledger event or a matching newest error-log entry as corroboration. Those are TRANSPORT-shaped evidence; a malformed or unresolved checker response settles its billing normally and writes neither. The checker-shape corroboration that remains: the halt must name a cell, the halted cell must have no result row, any abandonment that IS present in the window must still match the enumerated transient set, and the same-cell limit, resume cap, and uncertain-spend ceiling all still bind. UnknownChargeHalt corroboration is unchanged.
why: 2026-08-19 phase-3 canary round 2: two episodic checker_malformed halts on different cells (the first cell completed cleanly on resume, the classic phase-2 gemma checker signature that drove MAX_RESUMES to 400 there). The first auto-resumed only because unrelated transport noise happened to sit in its ledger window; the second had a clean window and stopped for manual review. All 107 cached checker responses in the run conform to the contract vocabulary, so this is provider-side episodic noise, not a new semantic failure of the checker prompt.
